sections.markdown:
## G - Definition of Done Matrix, Section Ten Financial Responsibility

DoD dispositions for the merged Section Ten dossier. Domains covered: the Financial Responsibility domain carries every Section Ten rule in part C. Passing standard: part A records it as unknown with no asserted value. High-yield ranked lists: present for the Financial Responsibility domain in parts C and C2. Misconceptions: covered as confusable pairs with stated differences in part C2. Mnemonics: not applicable, since the handbook section holds no field mnemonics. Glossary: key terms are defined inline in part C fact blocks. Dynamic isolation: part D records no time-variable facts, so nothing required isolation. Competitive teardown and market pack: recorded as scoped dispositions in parts E2 and E. Accuracy and verify list: attested in parts D and F.
